We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can use a placeholder or mention typical price. But we should not fabricate. We can say we don't have real-time data. Alternatively, we could provide a general answer: "I don't have real-time data." That is acceptable. There's no function to get gold price. So we respond accordingly.
